question: Under what temporal condition are old age and death destroyed?
premises: Practice is performed for one year.
When that practice has been done, a condition obtains.
Under that condition old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The nature of the practice is presupposed from preceding verses.
plain_english: When this has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
